error_message:
ERROR MESSAGE: "[UE 0] CB-RA: Contention resolution timer has expired, RA procedure has failed..."  
Context: This error occurs repeatedly after the RA-Msg3 transmission step in the random access procedure, indicating that the contention resolution timer expired before successful contention resolution, causing the Random Access (RA) procedure to fail and preventing UE connection establishment. The function/location context includes "In nr_Msg3_transmitted" and "[MAC]" module logs around frame.slot 696.17, 698.17, and 700.17.
